name: logo-creator
title_zh: 从草图到 SVG 的 AI 标志设计工坊
tagline_zh: 聊风格、调比例、出变体，改到满意再抠底导出矢量文件。不是丢一张图给你就完事，是陪你磨到能用的那版。
tagline_en: Discuss style, tweak ratios, generate variations, then crop, remove background, and export SVG. Not a one-shot.
desc_en: Create logos using AI image generation. Discuss style/ratio, generate variations, iterate with user feedback, crop, remove background, and export as SVG. Use when user wants to create a logo, icon, favicon, brand mark, mascot, emblem, or design a logo.
why_zh: 把「生成图」和「交付物」之间的鸿沟填平了：内置抠底和 SVG 导出，不用再拿着位图去找别的工具补救。
why_en: Bridges the gap between 'AI image' and 'deliverable': built-in background removal and SVG export mean no more rescuing bitmaps.
limit_zh: 只认 AI 图像生成这一条路，不接手工矢量重绘；导出 SVG 是自动描摹结果，复杂渐变或细线可能失真。
limit_en: Only works via AI image generation, no manual vector redraw. SVG export is auto-traced, so complex gradients/thin lines may distort. Needs clear.
title_en: AI Logo Studio: From Sketch to SVG
